decision_basis: XLSX row 2201, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, duplicate-code identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2202 / Wistron-HW-00483-V002 / bf3e06d5336b5718 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.

test_case.test_name: Variant-bound destructive E1.S NVMe MODS read/write integrity validation
test_case.purpose: Validate that the explicitly authorized E1.S namespace completes the approved MODS read/write and verification workload within signed integrity, health, endurance and performance criteria without touching any OS, mounted, array or valuable data.
required_package: Source Key/Variant identity and signed MODS package/module/version/hash/license/platform support
Bay/slot/BDF/controller serial/model/firmware plus namespace NGUID/EUI/UUID-to-path map
Disposable or verified-backup authorization and boot/mount/swap/LVM/RAID/dm/multipath/holder exclusions
Approved read/write mix, pattern, block size, queueing, LBA range/size, duration and verify semantics
Performance/error/endurance/temperature limits, aborts and restore/vendor-recovery plan
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending the exact vendor recipe, stable disposable namespace and destructive oracle. Once signed, use read-only inventory to match every physical and stable identifier and prove all active-stack exclusions; preserve SMART/error/endurance baseline; after separate destructive authorization run the exact MODS profile once only within the approved namespace/LBA range, preserving complete output and verification data; collect post-health and stop without retry on any mismatch or error.
test_case.expected_result: The exact authorized namespace alone receives the signed workload; MODS and data verification complete successfully; throughput/latency, temperature, media/error counters and endurance delta meet signed limits; no reset, target drift, active-stack impact or collateral data change occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS and no write while duplicate-code dispatch, package/command, stable target, disposable/backup status, LBA/workload/verify semantics or limits are unresolved. After approval, identity/holder drift, unauthorized range, verification mismatch, tool failure, reset, media/integrity error, health/endurance/temperature or performance-limit breach is FAIL. MODS help or enumeration cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until Source Key/Variant, exact MODS recipe, stable namespace identity, disposable/backup proof, active-stack exclusions, destructive range and recovery are signed.
Never select by code, `/dev/nvme*` order or substring; require bay/slot/BDF/serial and namespace stable-ID agreement.
No unmount, stack alteration, format/sanitize, firmware operation, log clearing, automatic write retry, restore or recovery unless separately approved.
Stop before write on any holder or identity ambiguity; stop once on reset, timeout, media/integrity error, temperature/health degradation or unexpected target change.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and explicit separation from row 2012 PCH Sensor Check
MODS package/module/recipe identity and destructive authorization
Bay/slot/BDF/controller/namespace stable-ID map plus read-only active-stack exclusion proof
Pre/post SMART/error/endurance/temperature plus full MODS stdout/stderr/exit/performance/integrity output
Reset, mismatch, stop/recovery and engineer-verdict record
test_case.recovery: On any identity drift, holder discovery, reset, timeout, media/integrity error or health degradation, stop once and preserve evidence; never rerun writes. Keep the affected namespace isolated and have the storage/vendor owner perform the signed restore or recovery after confirming no OS/array impact; automation does not format, sanitize, detach, restore or power-cycle.
